title: Posted cost analysis and explicit break-even scenario v1

scope.database: existing shared accounting AsyncSessionLocal, routing unchanged
scope.source: posted JournalEntry/JournalLine grouped by Account, company scoped on all three tables, selected branch and inclusive entry dates
scope.reversal_policy: include original and reversal postings; net debit/credit, do not filter is_reversed
scope.scenario: explicit unsaved user inputs: fixed costs, variable cost percentage, target sales; not inferred from GL or posted as a transaction
scope.consistency: read-only repeatable-read; private no-store API; hide offline/error/mismatched/stale financial data

limits: Not a certified P&L or a guarantee that every operational system has posted its sales/costs
Selected branch only, not company/brand/business-type consolidated or intercompany-eliminated reporting
Unallocated company-level entries are excluded rather than assigned arbitrarily
Recipe theoretical costs are not added to actual ledger COGS; recipe-to-actual variance integration is not included
Account names and classifications are current, not frozen historical snapshots
Break-even is a sales-value scenario, not a saved budget or per-item unit target
100 percent variable cost returns no break-even figure; no positive revenue returns no gross margin percentage
Accountant reconciliation, real operational completeness and physical acceptance remain pending

verification.isolated_restored_postgresql: passed: real SQL aggregates, reversals, contra revenue, unposted/date/branch exclusions, totals, scenario, no report writes
verification.browser_tests: 5 passed: tablet scenario, 100 percent edge, no writes, offline, mismatch, permission error, stale and empty states
verification.uat_read_smoke: passed: authorized-context service aggregation reconciles account totals, scenario 30000/60% yields 75000, unchanged schema creditsale0031

rollback: syntax verified; retained prior debt-aging-20261013 images; no DB migration or data rollback necessary; not exercised against healthy UAT
